info.title: AceData_Flux_Creative_Studio
info.description: Generate and edit images with Flux or create Flux 3 videos using the supported request modes. Retrieve tasks to collect finished media. Bind your own Ace Data Cloud credential privately as Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN in Authorization. Usage is billed to your account. Never place a token in chat or shared examples. Start: https://platform.acedata.cloud/?from=coze

parameters.name: accept
parameters.description: Specify the format of the response returned by the server. If not specified, the default format is `application/json`; if specified as `application/x-ndjson`, the response will be returned in a chunked streaming format separated by newline characters in JSON format.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Bind your own Ace Data Cloud credential privately as Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN in Authorization. Usage is billed to your account. Never place a token in chat or shared examples.

async.description: Whether to process in asynchronous mode. When set to `true`, the interface immediately returns `task_id`, without the need to provide `callback_url`, and then the result can be obtained by polling the corresponding task query interface; if `callback_url` is also provided, the result will be pushed to that callback address.

action.description: Types of operations for generating images. If it is `generate`, a new image will be created based on the prompt; if it is `edit`, the original image will be edited according to the prompt and `image_url`.

image_url.description: Link to the original image that needs editing.

callback_url.description: The callback address that will be called after the image generation is complete.

post.description: Flux AI image generation API, generates 1 image per request. Full input requirements: https://platform.acedata.cloud/documents/flux-images Submit once with async=true. Retain task_id and poll the matching task tool; a task ID is not a completed result. Do not resubmit while pending.
